sections.heading: Stage One: Browsing and Building Your Order

blocks.html: A canal-lined neighborhood with waterfront condos, marina slips, and beach-adjacent apartments has its own rhythm, and cannabis delivery here has to match it. Marina del Rey residents range from boat owners and weekend visitors to long-term renters and remote workers, and the way they shop reflects that variety. We built our delivery service to fit into busy days, quiet evenings, and everything in between.

blocks.html: Stage One: Browsing and Building Your Order
blocks.text: Stage One: Browsing and Building Your Order

blocks.html: Everything starts with the menu. When you open our online catalog, you see live inventory pulled directly from our shelves, so what you add to your cart is genuinely available. Each listing includes the strain name, cannabinoid percentages, the producer, and the product format. This lets you compare a high-THC concentrate against a balanced gummy or a low-dose beverage without guesswork.

blocks.html: As San Pedro’s first licensed cannabis dispensary, We Roll Up brings that same vetted selection to Marina del Rey through delivery. We sort products by category and effect so you can narrow choices quickly. If you are unsure where to begin, our staff is reachable to talk through options, and there is always a Spanish-speaking team member available to help. We want your first selection to feel as informed as your tenth.

blocks.html: Stage Two: Verification and Order Confirmation
blocks.text: Stage Two: Verification and Order Confirmation

blocks.html: California law requires age verification for every cannabis purchase, and delivery is no exception. After you place your order, we confirm that you are at least 21 for recreational purchases or hold valid medical documentation. Our driver will check a government-issued ID again at the door, matching it to the order on file. This protects you, protects the community, and keeps us fully compliant.

blocks.html: Once verified, your order is packaged in a sealed, tamper-evident bag and dispatched. We track each delivery from the moment it leaves the store until it reaches your address. That chain of custody matters in a coastal area where addresses include canal-front homes, gated complexes, and marina parking. Clear delivery notes from you help our drivers find the right entrance without delay.

blocks.html: Stage Four: Receiving and Enjoying Your Delivery
blocks.text: Stage Four: Receiving and Enjoying Your Delivery

blocks.html: When the driver arrives, the handoff is quick and straightforward. You confirm your identity, review your items, and complete the transaction. We keep things low-key and respectful, understanding that discretion matters whether you live in a quiet residential block or a busy waterfront building. After delivery, your products are yours to enjoy on your schedule.

blocks.html: We also offer in-store pickup and curbside pickup for anyone who prefers to grab an order on the way home or while running errands nearby. These options pair well with delivery, giving you flexibility depending on your day. Recreational users, medical patients, novices, and connoisseurs all use these services in different ways, and we designed each path to be simple.

blocks.html: Who Relies on Marina del Rey Delivery
blocks.text: Who Relies on Marina del Rey Delivery

blocks.html: Delivery solves real problems. A medical patient managing chronic discomfort may find it difficult to travel, so having topicals or low-dose edibles brought to the door preserves both comfort and dignity. A visitor staying in a short-term rental near the marina can restock without renting a car or navigating unfamiliar streets. Remote workers wrapping up a long day often prefer a delivery over a trip out, and weekend hosts plan ahead by ordering ahead of guests arriving.

Whether you are exploring cannabis for the first time or have a favorite you already know, We Roll Up is ready to deliver a positive, rewarding experience straight to your address.
